title: Fog of war
kicker: World and empire · sight and uncertainty
hook: **Fog of war** keeps other people’s ground and the past uncertain — your own held ground stays clear.

blindSpots.meaning: Uncertainty about ground you do not hold (and about memory of what was). Not a weather status on a lawn tile.
Holding a sector grants full sight of it — home turf is not a guessing game.
He evaluates from **his** fog. He does not peek at your save.
Moving carefully into uncertain ground so you learn what is there — not automatic full reveal of the map.

alsoTrue: Deeper fog craft and procedural generator work are Vision — see [world generator](world-generator).
Fog is about other people’s ground and about memory — not about hiding your own holdings from you.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Your own ground is clear. Other people’s ground and the past stay uncertain.
That asymmetry is the adventure: expand into fog, hold what you take, and never assume Zomboss shares your eyes.

cards.name: Hold
cards.body: Claimed sectors you keep give clear sight of that ground.

cards.name: Push
cards.body: March into fog to learn lanes and contacts the hard way.

cards.name: Opponent
cards.body: Zomboss plans under his own fog — fair war, not omniscience.

groups.title: On the World map
groups.intro: Fog is visible as soon as you leave fully held ground.
steps: Compare a held sector (clear) with neighbouring uncertain ground.
Scout one step carefully, then End Turn and reassess.
groups.note: Lenses that recolour fog or supply are WIP map tools — see [map orders](map-orders).

doSteps: Open the world map on ground you hold.
Look outward until the view turns uncertain.
March one careful step into fog and End Turn — notice what you learned vs what stayed dark.
doNote: Stop when fog ≠ “the map is broken.” Related: [world map](world-map), [Zomboss](zomboss-commander).

mixUps.q: Why can’t I see the whole map?
mixUps.a: Fog is intentional. Clear sight comes from holding ground and scouting.

mixUps.q: Does Zomboss cheat and see everything?
mixUps.a: No. He evaluates from his fog.

mixUps.q: Is my homeworld fogged to me?
mixUps.a: Holding a sector grants full sight of it — your own land stays clear.

mixUps.q: Is richer fog crafting in this build?
mixUps.a: Basic fog ships. Deeper craft and generator work are Vision.
